name: Tadami (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tadami town emblem in light blue: three stylised flower-like devices with rings, arranged in a triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Tadami, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in October 1968.

features.role: Tadami town emblem — three stylised flower-like devices with rings, arranged in a triangle
